prompt: Create a highly realistic casual smartphone selfie that looks like an authentic Instagram Story lifestyle snap taken outdoors in a Japanese city. The subject is a cheerful young woman, unnamed, with short blonde hair with soft face-framing bangs, warm natural makeup, clear glowing skin, small hoop earrings, and a gentle closed-mouth smile while looking directly into the phone camera. She is holding the phone high and slightly wide-angle, arm extended toward the lower-left foreground, creating a natural selfie distortion and an intimate candid feel. She wears a plain white crew-neck T-shirt tucked into light blue high-waisted denim shorts, a thin silver necklace, a white watch or bracelet, and carries a beige canvas tote bag over one shoulder. In her other hand she holds exactly 2 visible items: an iced coffee in a clear plastic cup with a domed lid and black straw, and a white plastic shopping bag. Set the scene on a sunny sidewalk near a crosswalk, with urban storefronts, leafy street trees, a cafe terrace with warm interior lights, tiled pavement, tactile paving, and exactly 1 parked bicycle visible on the right side. Include a few distant pedestrians in the background, softly blurred. Use late-afternoon golden-hour sunlight, natural shadows, realistic skin texture, subtle lens distortion, smartphone HDR look, shallow but not overly artificial depth of field, and a candid everyday fashion-photo mood. The overall atmosphere should be natural, friendly, stylish, and unposed. No text overlays, no watermark, no beauty-pageant posing, no studio lighting, no fantasy elements.

promptZh: 创作一张极具真实感的手机自拍，呈现出如同在 Instagram Story 上发布的日本城市户外生活照。主角是一位开朗的年轻女性，未命名，留着 修饰脸型的短金发刘海，妆容自然温暖，皮肤清透有光泽，佩戴小巧的圆环耳饰，对着手机镜头露出温柔的闭口微笑。她将手机举高并以略微广角的方式拍摄，手臂向左下方延伸，营造出自然的自拍畸变和亲切的抓拍感。她身穿纯白色圆领 T 恤，搭配浅蓝色高腰牛仔短裤，戴着细银项链和白色手表或手链，肩上背着一个米色帆布托特包。她的另一只手拿着 2 件清晰可见的物品：一杯带圆顶盖和黑色吸管的透明塑料杯装冰咖啡，以及一个白色塑料购物袋。场景设定在阳光明媚的人行道旁，靠近人行横道，背景可见城市店面、茂密的行道树、带有温暖室内灯光的咖啡馆露台、瓷砖路面、盲道，以及右侧停放的 1 辆自行车。背景中包含几位模糊处理的远景行人。采用午后黄金时段的阳光、自然阴影、真实的皮肤纹理、细微的镜头畸变、智能手机 HDR 质感、适度且不刻意的景深，以及随性时尚的抓拍氛围。整体氛围应为 自然、友好、时尚且不刻意摆拍。画面中不得包含文字叠加、水印、选美式摆拍、摄影棚灯光或奇幻元素。
